lines.text: Every full moon they danced under me. Then the last dance, and the doors closed.
lines.script: [dreamy, trilling, grand] Every full moon they danced under me. [dramatic wail, theatrical] Then the last dance, and the doors closed.
[booming diva, campy] From the top! [trilling, delighted] Round two!
[grandly, trilling, campy] Round 2. [swooping diva, theatrical] The band plays on.
[grandly, trilling, campy] Round 3. [swooping diva, theatrical] The band plays on.
[exasperated, posh, theatrical] Round 4. [swooping diva, dramatic] The band plays on.
[exasperated, posh, theatrical] Round 5. [weary diva, melodramatic] The band plays on.
[fainting, swooning, breathy] ...one more song. [melodramatic plea] Just one.

lines.text: They said see you next moon. 1971.
lines.script: [tragic, quivering, posh] They said see you next moon. [dramatic sigh, fond] 1971.

lines.speaker: The Mirrorball
lines.text: ...You asked me. Three times. Nobody has asked me to dance since 1971.
lines.script: [gasping, astonished, posh] ...You asked me. [trilling, disbelieving] Three times. [melodramatic sob, theatrical] Nobody has asked me to dance since 1971.

lines.speaker: The Mirrorball
lines.text: I don't need the moon. I just needed somebody to ASK.
lines.script: [haughty, then crumbling, theatrical] I don't need the moon. [swooning, tender, posh] I just needed somebody to ASK.

lines.speaker: The Mirrorball
lines.text: If I'm the brightest thing in the sky, somebody will HAVE to come.
lines.script: [grandly, swooping pitch, campy] If I'm the brightest thing in the sky, [booming diva, theatrical] somebody will HAVE to come.
